title: In Falcone Console
intro: Administration console for your organization on the In Falcone BaaS platform: manage your team’s access, your organization’s configuration and enabled services in one place, with authentication backed by Keycloak.
secureBody: Sign in with your organization account; only authorized people can enter the console.
signupBody: If your organization enables registration, you can request access and track your registration until it is active.
help: Need help signing in? Contact your organization’s administrator.
